name: Honjou Masato
source:
Hobbies: Gaming, watching football, internet, visiting PC shops.
Special skill: He is good with computers for a high school student.
Likes: Girls, curry, games, soccer, astronomy, the ocean, entomology.
Hates: Sassy guys, when girls give you the cold shoulder, other smart guys, guys with no etiquette on the web.

Masato is a third grader at Hamasaki high school. He is a kind, shy and geeky honor student. He absolutely loves girls, is romantic and sincere. Most likely because of his personality he has little to no male friends.

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/your_psp/chara_honjo.html]the official site (PSP edition)[/url].]
